changelog: Phase 32A — Pricing v3 + marketing strategy launch. Major version bump: SaaS pricing model restructured. (1) Killed Starter tier (2 990 ₽) — was a 'starter trap' with severely gutted features (no KDS/inventory/loyalty/marketing). (2) Pro trial extended 14d → 90 days, full Pro access — new acquisition funnel. (3) Annual billing variants added: Pro 69 900 ₽/year, Enterprise 199 900 ₽/year (2 months free, 16% discount, lock-in 2026 pricing). (4) Enterprise (19 990 ₽/mo) is now self-service with fixed price (was sales-only негot.) and includes bundled Express onboarding (3h) + 4h training (~24 900 ₽ value). (5) New tier enterprise_plus / Сеть (договорная, от 35 000 ₽/mo) — sales-led for chains 10+ locations, SSO, dedicated DB. (6) Add-on services catalog displayed: Express onboarding 9 900 ₽, Full onboarding 24 900 ₽, Migration from iiko/R-Keeper/QR/Poster 49 900 ₽, Group training 6 900 ₽, Individual training 4 900 ₽, Telegram-bot setup 4 900 ₽, custom domain 2 900 ₽, recorded video course 2 900 ₽, priority support +990 ₽/mo. (7) New marketing strategy doc canonical reference at docs/marketing-strategy-2026.md (competitor analysis 10+ players from iiko/R-Keeper to Frontpad/Quick Resto/Saby Presto, GTM playbook direct-sales-first M1-M3, KPI targets 12 mo). (8) New /index.php pricing section with 3-card grid + add-ons list. (9) Rewritten signup.php messaging (90 days emphasis, card-required hint). (10) /owner.php?tab=billing — new plan grid (Pro/Pro-annual/Enterprise/Enterprise-annual + Enterprise+ sales card) + add-on services section. Phase 32B (next): card-required signup flow via YK SaveMethod widget, AddonCatalog + addon_purchases table + /api/billing-purchase-addon.php, annual billing automation in SubscriptionStore (12-mo cycle), trial-end conversion cron (day 75/85 emails with annual lock-in offer 49 900 ₽).
